newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czechs sent guns to Zaire, Hutu rebel link denied.
newsitem.headline: Czechs sent guns to Zaire, Hutu rebel link denied.

text.p: The Czech Republic said on Thursday that it had exported handguns to Zaire but had checked on the spot and made sure they would not get into the hands of Rwandan Hutu rebels.

The Industry and Trade Ministry said the government was cooperating with a United Nations-appointed commission investigating violations of an arms embargo imposed after the 1994 ethnic massacres against minority Tutsis in Rwanda.

The ministry was responding to a report by the commission, obtained by Reuters at U.N. headquarters in New York, which said Hutu rebels in eastern Zaire had been amply supplied with arms from Europe and South Africa.
Zairean complicity ranked high in the report.

"Czech handguns and small calibre ammunition for them exported to this area (were) for the exclusive use of the official armed forces of Zaire," the ministry, which licences arms exports, said in a statement.

"This licence was granted only after checking the declared use of the requested arms shipment on the spot and after a written guarantee from the deputy prime minister who is in charge of defence in (Zaire) about its exclusive use for official army forces and excluding any possible re-export."
It did not name the deputy prime minister.

But it said: "On the basis of the controls which were carried out, it can be said that the illegal supplies of weapons to extremists of the Hutu tribe mentioned in the press do not have any connection with the actual supplies of Czech arms makers to the central African region."
It did not say how many guns had been sent or when. Some sporting and hunting rifles had also been exported to Zaire for civilian purposes, it said.
The former Czechoslovakia was a major arms exporter before the 1989 fall of communism. Since then a system requiring the approval of several ministries for arms exports has been set up.
The ministry said that when U.N. officials asked recently about sale to Africa "the Czech Republic handed over the relevant required data..."
After the 1994 Rwandan killings of more than 500,000 people, mostly Tutsis, a million Hutus fled to eastern Zaire including soldiers and militia.
The crisis escalated recently when Tutsis in Zaire fought the Zairean army, with refugees caught in the crossfire.
